name: OpenMascot
description: Your mascot, answering visitors on your own website. One script tag puts a branded assistant on any site: it answers from content you control, captures who asked, and hands the conversation to a real person whenever you want one. Run it as an AI first responder with human takeover, or turn the AI off and use it as a plain live-chat box under your own character.

deploy.title: Put your mascot on your website
deploy.subtitle: A branded assistant that answers visitors from your own content, and hands over to you when it matters.
